b: My 13 and 10 year old girls have a close friend group made up of 4 additional girls, three of whom are the same ages as them and one in between, age 11. The 11 year old is becoming the bane of my existence. I want to acknowledge that she’s a young girl and all of this behavior must be her way of trying to show us all she is hurting and needs something. Shes an only child and her parents are friends of mine, but also they leave her on her own far more than she likes. Her mom will go on long walks or go out to dinner with friends and then her dad will also go somewhere at the same time, so she ends up at my house. I had a text discussion about this with them, including how I feel a lot of implied responsibility for her because she will be at my house for an entire weekend, go home for an hour Sunday evening, and then come back and they just let her.

She seems to be incapable of not touching EVERYTHING. She’s ruined candles by picking at them. She throws mochis at the ceiling and walls leaving grease marks. She’s ruined my kids slimes and squishes even though I tell her not to touch anything (note: I am a single mom working full-time and I also have a six-year-old so I can’t supervise the older kids all of the time).

However, I think I’ve hit my limit. I am almost positive she has stolen two needohs from my 10 year-old. My 10 year-old had to get four teeth pulled out and I got her two needles as a consolation gift. One of them went missing after this specific friend was playing in my daughter‘s room. My daughter said she thought somebody took it, but I wanted to give her friends the benefit of the doubt so I said maybe it was lost, but I replaced it either way. Well that one has now gone missing as well. However, this time, no friends, other than the specific one have been in her room.

Please tell me if I’m being insane, but I have a spare ring doorbell, and I’m thinking of putting it on my daughter’s desk where she keeps her needohs (well, now singular Needoh). I could speak to the whole gang of kids and let them know they’ve been taken but this kid would never admit to it. She can also do no wrong in her parents’ eyes (she recently snuck out at 1:30am to go to the playground and her parents said she was grounded and not allowed to do any sleepovers for a bit; less than a week later she was allowed to to one meaning she didn’t even miss one). I am so done with this kid and feel like im at war with an 11 year old. She’s tiny and cute so can easily manipulate some people.
